title: Slices of the special linear algebraic cobordism spectrum
summary: Let $F$ be a field of exponential characteristic $e$. We compute the slices of $\mathbf{MSL}[e^{-1}]$, where $\mathbf{MSL}$ is the special linear algebraic cobordism spectrum defined by Panin and Walter. The answer is expressed in terms of the second page of the Adams-Novikov spectral sequence for the special unitary cobordism spectrum, which was explicitly determined by Novikov.
